increment_paragraph: MEASURE-TOOL-LANDING-PUBLISH wires `scripts/land.py publish` into the post-gate integrator sequence. It measures the committed landing SHA on all live routes, selects the nearest first-parent published ancestor for identity-verified `baseline:<sha>` reuse, requires explicit `--bootstrap` for the first `rev:` comparison, keeps each attempt in a fresh private path, and refuses dirty trees or an existing immutable baseline. The command-level test exercises bootstrap followed by baseline-side selection in a temporary Git repository. Native card-tip evidence and the scoped gate are in docs/reports/measure-tool-landing-publish/README.md; a combined-main publication and next-card reuse remain the follow-up's discharge condition.
status_paragraph: Landing baseline orchestration (MEASURE-TOOL-LANDING-PUBLISH): `scripts/land.py publish` now measures the committed landing SHA on the three live routes after the full gate and records commit, publishing an immutable baseline only on success. It selects a first-parent published ancestor for verified reuse and requires `--bootstrap` for the first publication. See docs/reports/measure-tool-landing-publish/README.md for card-tip evidence; no combined-main baseline is claimed by this card.

ledger.text: Card MEASURE-TOOL-LANDING-PUBLISH connected the publisher to scripts/land.py's post-gate sequence with clean-tree, first-parent baseline selection and explicit first-run bootstrap.
